_comment: Copy this file to rover_geometry.json and fill in your measured values. All distances in mm, pixels in down-camera space. The file is hot-reloaded every inference cycle — edit and save while the rover is running.
_icr_offset_mm_help: Distance from front camera lens to rear-axle ICR. Measure with a tape measure.
_down_px_per_mm_help: Place a known-size object under the down camera, count pixels it spans, divide by its real width in mm. e.g. credit card (85.6mm wide) spans 214px → 214/85.6 = 2.5
_rover_polygon_px_help: Pixel corners of the rover footprint as seen in the down-camera feed [x,y]. Click corners in the browser and note coordinates. Order: top-left, top-right, bottom-right, bottom-left.
_lookahead_s_help: Seconds ahead to project the drive arc. Reduce to 0.5 if rover stops too early, increase to 1.5 if vegetation is not caught in time.
_arc_steps_help: Number of integration steps along the arc. Leave at 10.
_exg_threshold_help: Excess Green threshold for vegetation detection (ExG = 2G-R-B). Increase (30-40) if soil/path turns green, decrease (10-15) if rows are missed.
_exg_min_area_help: Minimum blob area in pixels to count as vegetation. Increase to 1000-2000 to ignore small speckles.
_correction_goal_suffix_help: Text appended to base goal when correcting. {direction} is auto-filled with 'left' or 'right'.
